_finding: The dry run (docs/simulate-buy-tz.md §5.2, outside review of #266) runs a swap only to the pinned router, reads every word strictly, overrides only what the wallet lacks and reads it back (the stable's own isBlacklisted unchanged), keeps USDC's blocklist bit, never touches the stock token, attributes a wrapped revert only with evidence (the stable paid where the router pays, a token refusal with its own data while a control passes), and calls nothing would_succeed or would_revert that it could not show. would_succeed rests on the wallet's net balances in one eth_simulateV1 block around the swap (stable down by exactly the amount asked, token up by at least the minimum), its context pinned to the read block and checked; a revert is named only by the pinned routers' exact minimum-out errors, the stable's own blocklist answer, or a probe that reproduces the swap's own revert data while a control passes.

mutations.name: the router allowlist check is removed
mutations.expect: FAIL a build to any router but the pinned one is not simulated

mutations.name: the read-back check is removed
mutations.find: if ((gotBal & LOW_BITS) !== (wantBal & LOW_BITS) || gotAllow < amountIn) return { ...head1, ...unknown('override_unverified') }
mutations.expect: FAIL an override that does not read back

mutations.name: the blocklist bit is not preserved
mutations.expect: FAIL USDC's blocklist bit survives

mutations.name: a wrapped revert is classified from its own text, without the stable probe
mutations.find: const p1 = await call(stable, '0x' + SEL.transferFrom + abi.addr(wallet) + abi.addr(payTo) + abi.uint(amountIn), router, tag, ov)

mutations.name: an unattributed revert becomes would_revert
mutations.replace: return { ...head1, result: 'would_revert', amount_out_simulated_base_units: null, gas_units: null, revert: revertOf('token_rule', null) }
mutations.expect: FAIL a wrapped revert both probes pass

mutations.name: the stock token's address is allowed into the override object

mutations.name: the stable probe pays the router, not where the router pays

mutations.name: a call starts after the deadline

mutations.replace: const rc = (method, params) => rpcCall(fetchImpl, url, method, params)
